description: F-IO-011: an intra-community supply that cannot be reported is reported as unreportable. `ecSalesList` is keyed by VAT ID, and a supply whose partner has none produced no row and no warning — two postings, one with a VAT ID and one without, and the answer was one row and nothing else. That is the dangerous direction: without the recipient's VAT ID the supply is not exempt in the first place (§ 6a Abs. 1 Nr. 3 UStG), so what fell out of the report was exactly the case where something is wrong. The decision now happens on the LINE — is this tagged as an intra-community supply — before the partner is looked at; deciding it afterwards is what made a missing VAT ID indistinguishable from a posting that was never such a supply. Same shape as `vatReturn.gapWarnings`, and the same reason: the warning belongs at the figures rather than in a projection whoever files may never open. Not a refusal — whether a missing VAT ID makes the supply taxable is jurisdiction law and the embedding's call; the library's job is that the case is never invisible. Reported by an embedding application as its F-28, which had been walking `journalExport` to find these entries.

steps.comment: A customer whose VAT ID nobody entered — the ordinary way this happens, and the case that used to vanish.
And the second way to be unreportable: a voucher that names no partner at all. A different fix on the caller's side, so a different reason.

expect.comment: Eine meldbare Lieferung, zwei nicht meldbare — und die zwei stehen jetzt da, statt zu fehlen. Reihenfolge: Journalreihenfolge, wie bei vatReturn.
